pages.text: A golem mecha bow whose arrows cast a spell where they hit. Scribe it on a Scribe's Table like the Enchanter's Sword: no Form glyph, the bow provides Touch.$(br2)Ars Nouveau does not charge golems mana, so casts are limited by a cooldown (and an optional cost cap) in the config. Crafted at an Enchanting Apparatus from the matching diamond golem weapon.
